content.text:
Two wake-ups at 19 months is common but usually fixable with a consistent response: pick one approach (gradual check-ins or hold-and-leave) and keep it the same every time Remy stirs, so he learns that night is night. A rock-solid wind-down routine starting 30 min before bed - same order, same room - is the other lever that makes the biggest difference fastest.

Want the full night-by-night plan for Remy? Reply YES and I'll send it.
